title: Pratt Whitney gets $2.5 billion to service F-35 jet engines
big: 9 new stories. The new stories are led by drones; the top five are about drones, counter-drone, allies, ships and submarines, missiles and munitions.

stories.h: Pratt Whitney gets $2.5 billion to service F-35 jet engines
stories.what: The U.S. Navy has awarded RTX's Pratt Whitney a $2.53 billion contract to keep the F135 engine running across the global F-35 fleet for another year. That's roughly $925 million more than the deal it replaces.
stories.you: RTX has $2.5B on F-35. A rival has to unseat that incumbent to win the next lot.

stories.h: U.S. Navy orders three more E-130J test aircraft for $1.13 billion
stories.what: The U.S. Navy has awarded Northrop Grumman $1.13 billion to build three more test aircraft for the E-130J Phoenix II. The C-130J-based plane will take over the service's submarine communications relay mission from the aging E-6B Mercury.
stories.you: The Navy has $1.13B on E-130J. A rival has to unseat that incumbent to win the next lot.

stories.h: Japan takes delivery of AI-guided interceptor drones
stories.what: Japan has taken delivery of its first batch of Terra B1 interceptor drones, about three months after signing a mass-production contract, according to Tokyo-based maker Terra Drone.

stories.h: U.S. Army says first Dark Eagle hypersonic battery is ready
stories.what: The U.S. Army's first Dark Eagle hypersonic missile battery is now fully fielded and ready for combat, nearly three years after the original target date, the service's top weapons buyer for long-range fires said. It is fully fielded. It is ready to go, Lt.

stories.h: Four F-16 donors fund Ukraine’s biggest U.S. jet support package yet
stories.what: The U.S. State Department has approved a possible $621.9 million sale of F-16 sustainment equipment to Ukraine, paid for entirely by Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway.
stories.you: Four has $621.9 million on F-16. A rival has to unseat that incumbent to win the next lot.

idea.h: GPS-denied navigation module ('Intel Inside' for drones)
idea.why: A small vision, inertial and terminal-guidance board any airframe maker can integrate; later, quantum-ready. Jamming is everywhere; most vendors can't build autonomy in-house. As airframes become commodities, the margin sits in components like this.
